lines.en: I glide slowly through the air.
My metal joints click softly.

lines.zh: 半截身体是机械，走路也省力。
lines.en: Half of me is machinery; walking is easy.
I drift over without a sound beneath me.

lines.zh: 这条走廊配不上我的身份。
lines.en: This corridor hardly suits my rank.

lines.zh: 我抬着下巴，从你头上过去。
lines.en: Chin high, I pass over your head.
My tail tip sways gently.
I circle the battlefield once.

lines.zh: 机械的部分比肉身更听话。
lines.en: The machine half obeys better than flesh did.
I do not walk; I make a progress.
Rubble lifts and settles again as I pass.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，因为不必快。
lines.en: I do not fly fast, because I need not.
I hover and watch you all scurry.
My fingers tap against my arm.
This body is not bad at all.
I count up your battle powers.

lines.zh: 呼吸声里带一点金属味。
lines.en: There is metal in the sound of my breath.

lines.zh: 我慢慢握拳，又一寸寸松开。
lines.en: I clench my fist and open it slowly.
My mechanical eye keeps scanning.
This planet is so dirty and so small.
I laugh once, without warmth.
My tail traces an arc behind me.
Half of this body is machinery.
Light reflects off my plating.
This shell is harder than the old one.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，看它张开。
lines.en: I raise a hand and watch it open.

lines.zh: 就是你？看起来不怎么样。
lines.en: You? You do not look like much.
Your ki is laughably weak.

lines.zh: 我见过比你强百倍的家伙求饶。
lines.en: I have seen foes a hundred times stronger beg.
Those eyes had better look down.

lines.zh: 我曾经死过一次，不怎么在意。
lines.en: I died once already; it hardly matters.

lines.zh: 你把拳头握紧了，然后呢？
lines.en: You clenched your fist. And then?
I raise a hand and you step back.
You are afraid, and you hide it badly.

lines.zh: 这颗星球上还有能打的吗？
lines.en: Is there anyone worth fighting on this planet?

lines.zh: 我的耐心比这具身体还薄。
lines.en: My patience is thinner than this body's plating.
You may try to run. It would be amusing.

lines.zh: 你手里那点铁，收起来吧。
lines.en: Put away that scrap of iron.
I do not dislike those with spine.
If you wish to live, kneel first.
The angle of your upturned head is just right.

lines.zh: 我这只假眼，看得见你的心跳。
lines.en: This artificial eye of mine can see your heartbeat.
You cannot guess my battle power.
How do you plan to spend that life of yours?
You dared to touch me.
A crack in my shell.
This wound is of no consequence.
My stare has grown colder.

lines.zh: 机械部分发出刺耳的响声。
lines.en: My machinery grinds out a harsh noise.
I lift a hand to the fracture.

lines.zh: 记住，你只有这一次机会。
lines.en: Remember: you get one such chance.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，只是调整位置。
lines.en: I eased back only to reposition.
Blood runs along the metal seams.
I shall make you pay tenfold.
Food? I am no beast.
Put it down and take three steps back.
You dare serve me this?
I will taste it, for amusement.
This body has no need of food.
So you know how to flatter the strong.
Mediocre taste; I accept the gesture.

lines.zh: 别指望一顿饭换一条命。
lines.en: Do not think a meal buys a life.

lines.zh: 我举起来看了看，又放下。
lines.en: I lift it, look, and set it down.
You are of some small use after all.
Bumping me — do you court death?
My shell is harder than stone.
I do not budge; you are the one who recoils.
Three paces away. That is the rule.

lines.zh: 机械的肩撞得你发麻吧。
lines.en: That machine shoulder numbed you, did it not?
I lift my eyes to you once.
Do not come so close; you are not worthy.
Try touching me once more.
My tail sweeps aside what blocks me.
Your feet scrambled as you backed away.
Fight me? You have nerve.

lines.zh: 我出三分力，你撑过三招。
lines.en: I use a third of my strength; survive three exchanges.
Do not fall yet; I am not warm.
Interesting. You are still standing.
Again. Spend your life on it.
You will never learn this move.
I admit it: you are stronger than I thought.

lines.zh: 血肉之躯，也能做到这个地步。
lines.en: Flesh and blood, and yet you manage this.
I raise a hand, gesturing you onward.
Do not stop. Show me your limit.
Am I to pick up this junk?

lines.zh: 我捏起来，指缝就夹碎了。
lines.en: I pinch it and it crumbles between my fingers.
A mildly interesting little toy.

lines.zh: 半个机械身子的我，还会抛东西。
lines.en: Half machine, and I still toss things.

lines.zh: 战场上剩下什么，我都要。
lines.en: Whatever the battlefield leaves, I take.
This is not worth bending for.

lines.zh: 我收进机械臂里的格子。
lines.en: I stow it in a compartment of my arm.

lines.zh: 你就这么掉了，真不小心。
lines.en: So you dropped it. How careless.
I weigh it — very light.
It is mine now. No thanks needed.
I shall start with you.
You are already locked in.
My ki is gathering.

lines.zh: 你跑动的路线，我算出来了。
lines.en: I have calculated your escape path.
This will not take long.
The death ball turns slow. Dodge it.

lines.zh: 你左肋的空当露出来了。
lines.en: The gap at your left ribs is showing.
I like to come from above.
One finger will be enough.
How many seconds can you last?
The ki blast is charged.

lines.zh: 我笑，是因为我知道结局。
lines.en: I smile because I know the ending.
Turning will not save you either.
I am taking that life.
Hold still; it will be quicker.
I dislike prey that struggles.
I circle you slowly in the air.
There is nowhere you can retreat to.

lines.zh: 我预判你下一步的动作。
lines.en: I predict your next motion.
Your hand is shaking. I see it.

lines.zh: 我的影子先罩住你的脚。
lines.en: My shadow covers your feet first.

lines.zh: 你每一次呼吸我都记下。
lines.en: I record every breath you take.
I am in the air; you are in the mud.
This ground is under my control.
You have looked back for an exit three times.
My beam is taking aim.

lines.zh: 你听，那是我充能的声音。
lines.en: Listen. That is my charge building.
Surrender, or die.

lines.zh: 你的力气在流走，我不急。
lines.en: Your strength is draining. I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你的同伴已经跑了，聪明。
lines.en: Your companions fled. Wise of them.
I wait for you to slip.
This round I shall not yield.

lines.zh: 你的挣扎让我有点兴致。
lines.en: Your struggling is mildly entertaining.
The last second is always the slowest.
One finger, through your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我出现在你后颈的位置。
lines.en: I appear at the back of your neck.
The combination begins.
My fist comes wrapped in light.
You are hammered flat to the ground.
I held back on that one.
A ki wave bursts from my palm.
You did not even see the shadow of it.
A death ball cracks open at your feet.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下来，一脚压住你。
lines.en: I dive and pin you with a foot.
The blood you cough up is warm.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，看你还站不站。
lines.en: I step back to see if you rise.
My mechanical arm shrieks.

lines.zh: 这一击让你飞出去很远。
lines.en: This blow sends you flying far.
I shake my hand; my fingertips are hot.
Good. You are not dead yet.
The ground cracks as I descend.

lines.zh: 机械与血肉拼成的身影出现了。
lines.en: A shape of flesh and machinery appears.
I press down slowly from the sky.
This new body feels good.

lines.zh: 我来看看这颗星球上有什么。
lines.en: I have come to see what this planet holds.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先着地，然后是我。
lines.en: My tail lands first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 你们的小打小闹到此为止。
lines.en: Your squabbling ends here.
I raise my hand and the field falls silent.
My pod settles behind me.

lines.zh: 光环在我脚边转了一圈。
lines.en: A halo of light circles my feet.
I sneer and let my ki spill out.
Dust is pushed outward in a ring.

lines.zh: 又一颗星球要记住我的名字。
lines.en: Another planet will remember my name.

lines.zh: 我落在最中间，理所当然。
lines.en: I land in the center, as is fitting.
Look up. Do not make me repeat it.
This place is mine now.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在喊我的名字。
lines.en: I hear someone speaking my name.
The pressure leaves you unsteady.
Fire? This body does not burn easily.

lines.zh: 落地砸出一个坑，膝盖发麻。
lines.en: I hit the ground and my knee goes numb.

lines.zh: 水压挤着我的机械关节。
lines.en: Water pressure squeezes my mechanical joints.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的气浪推了我一下。
lines.en: The blast wave shoves me off line.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在装甲的缝里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in a seam of my plating.

lines.zh: 这种力量，不属于这颗星球。
lines.en: This power does not belong to this planet.
My energy reserves are dropping.

lines.zh: 雷击让我的系统短暂失灵。
lines.en: The lightning briefly scrambles my systems.
The void is gnawing at my machinery.
